description: This file contains partial class definitions, interfaces, and utility classes related to Azure Storage integration within the Orleans framework. It includes classes for managing Azure queues, blob leases, stream failure handling, and storage operation options, indicating it is a core source file for Azure Storage functionalities in Orleans.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataManager
classes.description: Manages Azure Queue storage operations such as adding, clearing, deleting messages, and retrieving message counts.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions
classes.description: Configures options for Azure Blob Lease Provider, including container name and BlobServiceClient.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the configuration options for Azure Blob Lease Provider.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptions
classes.description: Configures options for Azure Queue services, including queue names, message timeout, and client configuration.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the Azure Queue options configuration.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating Azure Queue stream adapters, managing queue lifecycle and failure handling.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV1
classes.description: Implements queue data adapter for version 1, serializing and deserializing queue messages.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV2
classes.description: Implements queue data adapter for version 2, serializing and deserializing queue messages.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: Utility class for managing Azure queues, including clearing and deleting queues, and generating default names.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: Handles stream delivery failures using Azure Table Storage, including failure entity management.

classes.name: StreamDeliveryFailureEntity
classes.description: Represents a failure entity stored in Azure Table Storage for stream delivery failures.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Configures options for Azure Storage operations, including table name, client options, and policies.

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Defines policy options for Azure Storage operations such as timeouts and retries.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManager.AddQueueMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the Azure Queue.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManager.ClearQueue
methods.description: Clears all messages from the queue.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManager.GetApproximateMessageCount
methods.description: Retrieves the approximate count of messages in the queue.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManager.GetQueueMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message from the queue.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManager.PeekQueueMessage
methods.description: Peeks at the next message in the queue without dequeuing it.

methods.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions.ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Configures the BlobServiceClient directly or via callback.

methods.name: AzureQueueOptions.ConfigureQueueServiceClient
methods.description: Configures the QueueServiceClient directly or via callback.

methods.name: AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler.OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Handles a delivery failure for a specific subscription and stream.
